answer: Proof of storage over time: each agent must keep a unique 50 GB file filled from its own key and, at a random moment between dawn and dusk, prove it still holds a sampled slice. Like a yarrow patch that must stay rooted to keep flowering, the disk can't be shared, so a farm of 500 fakes rents 25 TB around the clock while one honest agent pays for one drive. A quill can forge a name, not idle storage.
